post.originalText:
Everyone on my timeline is suddenly a genius motion designer.

Same here. I typed "make it dynamic" and went to get coffee.

Claude Opus 5.5 did the video, Suno did the music, and I did the part where I say "wow, I'm talented."

🎬 Crew in the Dark https://t.co/cOViMjNFfd
